What if you lived on a planet the size of a house?
Make it out of rock, like Earth, about ten metres across.
Its gravity would be about a million times weaker than Earth's.
To escape it forever, you'd only need to move at about one centimetre per second. That's slower than an ant walking.
So one normal step, and you'd drift off into space. Forever.
It couldn't hold on to any air, either. You'd need a spacesuit just to stand there.
Rocks this small really exist in space, and spacecraft that land on them have to grab on, or bounce away.
Would you visit it? Tell me in the comments.
